t: Duckhams QS 5W-30 engine oil is a fully synthetic lubricant designed for modern vehicle engines. It is suitable for mechanics and vehicle technicians maintaining a range of petrol and diesel cars. The high-performance oil meets ACEA C2 specifications, ensuring compatibility with engines equipped with exhaust after-treatment systems, including diesel particulate filters (DPFs). Its advanced formulation provides engine protection, helps maintain system efficiency, and promotes good fuel economy for optimal vehicle performance.
